title: K-Means Clustering
description: Interactive animated k-means clustering with real-time inertia charting.

libraries.label: Binary Heap & Indexed Priority Queue
libraries.description: Used in K-Means++ initialisation to sample the next centroid with probability proportional to squared distance. The IndexedPriorityQueue enables O(log n) priority updates when distances change across iterations.

libraries.label: Van Emde Boas Tree
libraries.description: O(log log U) integer set with successor/predecessor queries. In quantised feature spaces, vEB trees provide fast discrete cluster-index lookup and ordered traversal over the active centroid set.
